items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VII, List of Answers on Topics 12:1
items.html: They are mainly Hassadim and Gevurot, except that they contain an illumination of Hochma, namely according to the measure of stature that is then in AVI: if they are at the stature of Keter, then these Mochin are from the phase of the illumination of Hochma of the Partzuf of Keter. And if they are at the stature of Hochma, the Mochin are found from the phase of the illumination of Hochma of the Partzuf of Hochma, and so on. (p. 518, Sub Header, “And in this you shall understand”)
